title: project-defined screening illustration
label: ASSUMPTION
equation: disk_loading_pa = quantize(thrust_n / disk_area_m2, 0.001); induced_velocity_m_s = quantize(sqrt(thrust_n / (2 * air_density_kg_m3 * disk_area_m2)), 0.001); ideal_power_kw = quantize((thrust_n * induced_velocity_m_s) / 1000, 0.001); shaft_power_kw = quantize(ideal_power_kw / figure_of_merit, 0.001); power_margin_ratio = quantize((power_available_kw - shaft_power_kw) / power_available_kw, 0.001).
note: Screening illustration, not a certification method. Not attributed to a handbook.
